shortDescription: An invisible-when-worn Blåhaj plush for the utility slot, boosting learning and comfort, plus small and rotatable three-tile furnishings.
body: Adds three fabric/leather Blåhaj plush items using the supplied shark texture. The wearable is apparel assigned to the Belt layer (RimWorld utility slot), crafted at hand or electric tailoring benches, requires Complex Clothing research, and provides +10% LearningRateFactor and +0.05 Comfort while equipped; its wornGraphicPath is empty to suppress pawn rendering. Two fabric/leather furniture decorations are crafted at tailoring benches, require Complex Clothing, and add Beauty 10 (one tile) or Beauty 20 (three tiles). The larger building is rotatable and has footprint (3,1), so its occupied footprint rotates with building orientation. Both furniture defs use MinifiedThing so they can be moved/stored.
